signal: For each frame evaluate both native green subplanes at the existing preview window. Use peak above median divided by the robust ring-noise estimate. Use the minimum across green parities and the two frames. Clip the squared ratio to the training median to [0.25,4].
comparison: Use exact archived stellar centroids and same train and held-out IDs. Huber uses source parameters with either unit or signal base weights. Reused tracks and fixed reference prevent independence across exposures.
